title: Assistant Professor in Computer Science

important_dates.label: Last date for submitting application form in online mode
Last date for submitting application form hardcopy in the office of the undersigned

summary: Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University invites online applications for the temporary post of Assistant Professor in Computer Science on a fixed salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month for the Academic Session 2026-2027. Interested candidates must apply online through the university careers portal and submit the hard copy of their application with required enclosures by December 7, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Master's degree with 55% marks in a relevant/allied subject from an Indian or accredited foreign university.
Must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC/CSIR or equivalent test like SLET/SET, or hold a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC regulations.
For instructors, B.Tech. in Computer Engineering or AI with first division is alternatively required.
how_to_apply_steps: Fill out the online Application Form at the Careers Portal of the University (careers.amuonline.ac.in).
Pay the non-refundable processing fee of Rs. 500/- online.
Take the printout of the PDF file of the application form on A-4 size paper, sign it, and paste a recent photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of all relevant degrees, mark sheets, experience, and certificates.
Submit the complete application form by post to the Office of the Centre of Professional Courses, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002 on or before the last date.
